sentences.s: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.

trunk.宾语或表语: how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time

components.原文: Tracing the history of the term
components.中文翻译: 追溯这一术语的历史
components.说明: 现在分词短语作方式/时间状语，逻辑主语是主句主语 we。

components.原文: how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time
components.中文翻译: “科学素养”的定义随着时间推移不断变化
components.说明: how 引导宾语从句作 see 的宾语。

components.原文: muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education
components.中文翻译: 这也使得确定科学教育的目标变得棘手
components.说明: 现在分词短语作结果状语，承接前面的「定义不断变化」；muddy the waters 是习语，意为「把事情搅浑、使复杂化」。

components.原文: when it comes to determining the goals of science education
components.中文翻译: 当涉及确定科学教育的目标时
components.说明: when it comes to 为固定搭配，to 是介词，后接动名词。

sentences.zh: 追溯这一术语的历史，我们可以看到“科学素养”的定义随着时间推移不断变化，这也使得确定科学教育的目标变得棘手。

sentences.s: A return to that version of scientific literacy, which focused more on teaching what science is and how it works and less on memorizing scientific facts, seems like something society today desperately needs.

trunk.主语: A return to that version of scientific literacy
trunk.主干翻译: 回归那种科学素养观，似乎正是当今社会迫切需要的

components.原文: to that version of scientific literacy
components.中文翻译: 对那种科学素养观的
components.说明: of/to 短语后置修饰抽象名词 return。

components.原文: which focused more on teaching what science is and how it works and less on memorizing scientific facts
components.中文翻译: 更侧重于教授“科学是什么”以及“科学如何运作”，而非死记硬背科学事实
components.说明: which 引导非限制性定语从句，与主语隔开较远，翻译时宜用破折号插入。

components.原文: and less on memorizing scientific facts
components.中文翻译: 更侧重于……而非……
components.说明: focus more on A and less on B 的并列比较结构。

components.原文: what science is and how it works
components.中文翻译: “科学是什么”以及“科学如何运作”
components.说明: 两个并列的宾语从句作 teaching 的宾语。

components.原文: society today desperately needs
components.中文翻译: 当今社会迫切需要的
components.说明: 省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 something。

sentences.zh: 回归那种早期版本的科学素养观——更侧重于教授“科学是什么”以及“科学如何运作”，而非死记硬背科学事实——似乎是当今社会迫切需要的。

sentences.s: Educators advanced the idea of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools in the belief that such work was beneficial primarily as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills.

trunk.主干翻译: 教育工作者曾提倡这样一种想法……

components.原文: of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools
components.中文翻译: 让学生在高中完成详尽的实验练习
components.说明: of + 动名词复合结构作 idea 的同位语，说明这一想法的内容；have sb. do sth. 意为「让某人做某事」。

components.原文: in the belief that such work was beneficial
components.中文翻译: 因为他们相信这类活动是有益的
components.说明: in the belief that… 意为「相信……」，可译成原因。

components.原文: that such work was beneficial primarily as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills
components.中文翻译: 这类活动主要益于培养逻辑推理能力和观察能力
components.说明: that 引导同位语从句，说明 belief 的具体内容。

components.原文: to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills
components.中文翻译: 用来培养逻辑推理能力和观察能力
components.说明: 不定式作 way 的后置定语兼目的。

sentences.zh: 教育工作者曾提倡让学生在高中完成详尽的实验练习，因为他们相信，这类活动主要益于培养逻辑推理能力和观察能力。

sentences.s: It wasn’t until the phrase “scientific literacy” came along in the 1940s that science had the formidable slogan it needed to command public attention and make improving science education an important national goal.

trunk.主干翻译: 科学才拥有了那个强有力的口号

components.原文: It wasn’t until the phrase “scientific literacy” came along in the 1940s that
components.中文翻译: 直到……科学才拥有了强有力的口号
components.说明: It is not until A that B 的强调句型，强调时间状语；译成「直到……才……」。

components.原文: until the phrase “scientific literacy” came along in the 1940s
components.中文翻译: 直到20世纪40年代“科学素养”这一短语出现
components.说明: 被强调的部分是 until 引导的时间状语从句；come along 意为「出现、问世」。

components.原文: it needed to command public attention and make improving science education an important national goal
components.中文翻译: 足以吸引公众关注并使提升科学教育成为一项重要国家目标的
components.说明: 省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 slogan；it 指代 science。

components.原文: and make improving science education an important national goal
components.中文翻译: 并使提升科学教育成为一项重要的国家目标
components.说明: and 连接 command 与 make 两个并列不定式；make + 宾语 + 宾补，宾语是动名词短语 improving…。

sentences.zh: 直到20世纪40年代“科学素养”（scientific literacy）这一短语出现，科学才拥有了一个强有力的口号，足以吸引公众关注，并使提升科学教育成为一项重要的国家目标。

sentences.s: The intense focus on scientific literacy in the United States originally grew out of the critical role of science and technology during World War II, as well as the perceived deficiencies of American soldiers.

trunk.主语: The intense focus on scientific literacy
trunk.宾语或表语: the critical role of science and technology
trunk.主干翻译: 对科学素养的强烈关注源于科技所起的关键作用

components.原文: on scientific literacy in the United States
components.中文翻译: 美国对科学素养的
components.说明: 两个介词短语层层后置修饰 focus。

components.原文: during World War II
components.中文翻译: 第二次世界大战期间
components.说明: 时间状语，限定 role 发挥作用的时期。

components.原文: as well as the perceived deficiencies of American soldiers
components.中文翻译: 以及当时人们所感知到的美国士兵（在科学素养方面）的不足
components.说明: as well as 连接 grew out of 的两个并列宾语；perceived 是过去分词作定语，意为「被认为的、人们所感知到的」，不是「察觉」。

sentences.zh: 美国对科学素养的强烈关注，最初源于第二次世界大战期间科学技术所发挥的关键作用，以及当时人们所感知到的美国士兵在科学素养方面的不足。
